items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: Simeon played somewhat on Jimmy Noon's style. But they both, I guess they played together in the old ways.

ctx.x: Simeon was pretty well developed when he came?

Oh yes, Simeon. Simeon played somewhat on Jimmy Noon's style. But they both, I guess they played together in the old ways. And of course now this fellow, Nichols, we used to play with Joe, Nichols and Bonnie, you know, because they were a great team.
An awful lot of clarinets came out of New Orleans.

items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Well, I think that Jimmy Noon was a great musician. I think, if I make no mistake, I think he wrote Sweet Lorraine.

ctx.x: That's what I understand. Are there any of the other New Orleans musicians? I keep sort of bringing you back to that. I'm not trying to make you talk about only them, but I wondered any other fellows that you could talk about from New Orleans or do you remember the other musicians that you might have worked with?
Well, I think that Jimmy Noon was a great musician. I think, if I make no mistake, I think he wrote Sweet Lorraine.
That was his theme song anyway, I'm sure.
